# POS send Purchase command, Terminal reply ACK
# Terminal send response data with wrong LRC, POS expected to send NACK
# Terminal resend response data with wrong LRC, POS expected to send NACK
# Terminal resend response data with wrong LRC, POS expected to send NACK
# POS should prompted for APPROVED/FLAGGED the transaction or 

For such situations it is recommended to perform the following:
1) Check on terminal receipt for the payment status and POS close and process accordingly.
2) Repeat same payment with the same ECN
3) Check on last approved transaction
4) Check on the response code and if it’s approved, POS proceed to close the payment.
